beats.speech: Stop saying very sorry. Here are three better words.
Apologetic: Tom broke Mia's mug. He gave an apologetic smile.
Regretful: Mia didn't smile back. Now he felt regretful.

card.headline: Remorseful
card.use: He bought her a new mug.

beats.speech: Remorseful: He bought her a new mug. He wrote a remorseful note.
Which word will you use? Comment yours!
